answer: Each identity enters a 16-epoch service voyage. After commitment, a lagoon beacon assigns four unrelated clients; the kth account in one funding cluster must serve 4k clients, so 100 aliases owe 20,200 verified deliveries. A nectar Merkle root binds assignments, receipts, and outputs. Validators replay 10% of jobs; a reused client or copied result burns a 40-POA bond and resets every linked voyage.
